story_type: hurricane hunter turbulence inside the cabin
hook: Gear flew across the cabin inside Hurricane Milton.
narration: Gear flew across the cabin as this plane punched into Hurricane Milton.
It was NOAA's WP-3D Orion, nicknamed Miss Piggy, flying into the storm on purpose.
On October eighth, Milton strengthened again to Category 5 winds.
The crew rode it out strapped to their seats as the plane bucked and dropped.
Hurricane hunters fly through the storm to collect data that sharpens the forecast for people on the coast.
[short pause] Then the ride finally smoothed out.
outcome: Miss Piggy rode out the turbulence and flew on above the clouds, crew and data aboard.
title: Hurricane hunter rides into Milton
description:
On Oct. 8, 2024, NOAA's WP-3D Orion hurricane hunter "Miss Piggy" took a bumpy ride into Hurricane Milton in the Gulf of Mexico to collect data for forecasts.

Footage: NOAA Hurricane Hunters video, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hurricane_Milton_on_a_NOAA_WP-3D_Orion.webm
